failure_description: Launch random vibration testing (14.1 Grms, 20-2000 Hz) cannot be executed in standard university/ground laboratory.
root_cause: Requires certified 50 kN 3-axis electrodynamic shaker table facility accredited for space qualification testing.
corrective_action: Formal Vibration Test Plan (ASTRA-QTP-VIB-001) authored; payload CAD mounting analyzed with fundamental resonance > 60 Hz.
